thread:
Tom (Sales): quick handoff for Novara Health. Signed 12mo private deployment. Key asks: stabilize inference p95 for short prompts, SSO validation, and an enablement pack for their ops team. Renewal flagged if perf not improved by Q1 2027. Tech contacts: Priya (customer), Raj (infra). Target launch 2026-05-20.

Lina (CS): I'll own the onboarding plan and single-thread coordination. Proposed kickoff Mon 2026-05-04. Owners: Lina = onboarding lead, Ravi = perf triage, Nora = SSO + runbook, Alyssa = renewal/AM. Can we confirm demo repro artifacts here?

Tom (Sales): attaching minimal repro and demo notes below. They saw spikes only on multi-chunk summarization flows.

```bash
# demo repro snippet
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-xxxx" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-13b-q8","input":"<doc>...<doc>\nQ: extract bullets"}'
# observed: median 1.8s for small prompts, tail spikes to 25s when doc > 6k tokens
```

Ravi (Eng): picking up perf triage. Will open INF-1321 and run a 24h trace. Need: model binary name + quant flags, demo batch sizes, and any custom runtime params used in demo. Lina 12 can you request logs and a short prompt set from the customer?

Nora (Support): I'll draft the SSO checklist and validation steps. We need the SP metadata + at least one test account with SAML attribute mapping. Also will build an ops runbook (failover steps, who to call, observability queries).

Ops Bot: New ticket created: INF-1321 (Novara perf trace) 12 assigned to Ravi (Eng). Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-1321

Lina (CS): asked Priya for logs + SP metadata and a tech contact for peering. Scheduled kickoff Mon 2026-05-04 09:00 PT (invite: Priya, Raj, Tom, Ravi, Nora, Alyssa). Lina will upload artifacts to shared bucket when received.

Alyssa (AM): noting renewal watch. I'll prepare a short mitigation plan to share with Novara: 1) immediate perf triage + timeline 2) temporary SLA credit language if we see regression 3) follow-up Q1 check. Lina 12 please keep me updated on triage milestones so I can brief leadership.

Ravi (Eng): initial plan: reproduce on infra mirror, collect KV-cache heatmap, check batching/backpressure, and verify quant path. If reproduces, try quick mitigations: smaller eager batching for large-doc flows, prefix cache adjustments, and kernel tweaks. ETA initial findings 48h.

Nora (Support): will draft SSO runbook by EOD and include test matrix (IdP flows, assertion attributes, metadata validation commands). Will also include a pre-launch checklist for Priya's infra team.

Lina (CS): next steps summary: Lina request artifacts (today), Ravi starts INF-1321 reproduction (today), Nora drafts SSO runbook (EOD), Alyssa drafts renewal mitigation note (tomorrow). We'll surface status in weekly onboarding updates.

Tom (Sales): thanks team. Priya replied in email: "Uploading logs and a test user tonight." I've forwarded note to the invite list. :thumbsup:

Lina (CS): closing loop for now 12 please post any logs or tickets here. We'll escalate to oncall if we see production-impacting traces.
